item.title: Dallas Zoo launches $25 wild pass for spring break savings
item.description: The Dallas Zoo has launched a $25 Wild Pass which bundles several popular attractions into a single discounted price for families, including unlimited rides on two mechanical attractions, interactive animal experiences, and access to a virtual reality exhibit.

item.title: Texas ranks second in U.S. for interest in women's sports
item.description: Texas ranks second in the US for engagement with women's sports, with an average of 658,520 monthly Google searches related to women's basketball, soccer, golf, and tennis, behind only California.

item.title: Silver Fox Steakhouse to host exclusive Easter brunch
item.description: Silver Fox steakhouse locations in Richardson and Fort Worth will host an exclusive Easter Sunday brunch on April 5, featuring a Roasted Tenderloin Benedict and drink specials, with reservations recommended.

item.title: Manny's Mexican Kitchen opens, serving authentic cuisine at Cityline
item.description: Manny's Mexican Kitchen has opened a new elevated dining concept at CityLine, featuring a colorful interior and a menu of traditional Mexican dishes and cocktails.

item.title: Frontiers of Flight Museum to host Dallas Cowboys legend, aviator Chad Hennings for talk
item.description: Former Dallas Cowboys star and fighter pilot Chad Hennings will be speaking at the Frontiers of Flight Museum on April 30 to discuss his experiences in both combat aviation and professional football.

item.title: 2026 Oscars could see over 50 historical records broken
item.description: The 98th Academy Awards in 2026 could see more than 50 historical records broken, with several films and individuals positioned to achieve milestones.

item.title: Weather alert: North Texas braces for severe storms
item.description: Severe storms are possible in North Texas on Wednesday night into Thursday morning, bringing chances for hail, damaging winds and a low tornado risk.

item.title: Apple’s March event: The affordable MacBook Neo steals the show
item.description: It’s Apple Launch Week – and the affordable MacBook Neo is already coveted.

item.title: SusieCakes unveils Easter and Passover dessert lineup
item.description: SusieCakes will begin accepting pre-orders for its spring holiday dessert lineup, featuring a variety of made-from-scratch treats designed for Easter and Passover celebrations.

item.title: Four new tenants, including IKEA, join the Shops at Park Lane
item.description: The Shops at Park Lane in Dallas is expanding its retail and service offerings with four new tenants, including a small-format IKEA store, Connect Studio DFW, Intuit Turbo Tax, and Crème + Crepe.
